$comment: Advisories reviewed and accepted for now. Anything not listed here fails `pnpm audit:check`. Each entry needs a reason; regenerate with `pnpm audit:baseline` and then write real reasons before committing.

GHSA-2pr8-phx7-x9h3.title: protobuf.js: Denial of service from crafted field names in generated code
GHSA-2pr8-phx7-x9h3.reason: Transitive, and unreachable. It arrives through @trezor/connect, which Stellar Wallets Kit pulls in for hardware-wallet support. packages/stablecoin-kit/src/wallet.ts registers only browser-extension modules (Freighter, xBull, Albedo, Rabet, Lobstr, Hana), so no Trezor code path is ever imported or executed, and its postinstall build is denied in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Fixing it needs a major upgrade of @creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit — a deliberate migration, not a bot bump.
